Hey!

I’m Jayasundara, a builder based in Sri Lanka, creating websites, networks, and visuals with modern tools and AI-assisted workflows.

I’m a web designer and developer with a strong focus on clean UI/UX and responsive layouts, backed by hands-on networking skills in infrastructure setup, security basics, and troubleshooting.

I also work in graphics design, photo editing, and video editing for brand identity, and I use vibe coding with AI-assisted builds and rapid experimentation to turn ideas into working products faster.
